limits: Checked-in COV reachability is historical discovery, not current enabled UI proof.
An audit call, Some value or C2 registration does not prove complete/trusted history.
Tables accessed include validation reads and are not an inferred write set.
Rust parameter fields describe source inputs, not an approved proposal field allowlist.
Native functions without canonical contracts remain explicit reconciliation work.
Runtime UI/native/import/job coverage, policy/retention decisions and history acceptance remain open.

signal_semantics.audit_signal: Direct reducer body only; delegated capture may exist. Some values do not prove completeness or trust.
signal_semantics.capture_signal: A direct helper call is partial-control-flow evidence, not coverage of every branch or native acceptance.
signal_semantics.params: References into parameter_products; field names are source inputs, never an approved proposal allowlist.
signal_semantics.commit_registration_signals: Existing C2 source registrations only, never proof of complete business history.
signal_semantics.entry_paths: Every row needs native-owner review; session rows additionally need BFF/UI review. Imports, bulk actions and jobs must converge through the same owner.
